note: T06A07 as shipped: create, list and revoke over HTTP; the secret appears once in the 201 body and the row keeps only key_prefix plus an HMAC-SHA256 of the full key under HMAC_KEY; every bad key (malformed, unknown prefix, wrong secret, revoked) answers the same 401 API_KEY_INVALID; another merchant's key id answers 404, not 403; a key resolves to the same principal a session does and carries only its granted scopes; PT-15 is proved through that principal on a merchant-scoped read.
tests: tests/integration/test_bid_sealing.py (the session half of the same sealing rule)
not_covered_by_this_phase: The ten /merchant-api/v1/* routes that consume require_merchant_key arrive with T07A06, so a key has no agent-facing endpoint to call in this build; require_scope is delivered and tested for the routes that will call it.

The 120 requests per minute per key limit in api.md section 4.3 is not implemented: no Phase 6 task names it, and the limiter belongs to the routes that will need it (T07A06). The in-repo UserRateLimiter is the shape to reuse.
No hosted key has been issued: creating one needs the merchant's three attestations accepted, which the live demo merchant has on the hosted database but not on a fresh local one.
